title: fillet
body:
## fillet

Rounds selected edges of an existing solid with one constant radius (native Part::Fillet) and produces a solid. Select edges either by one-based index in the base solid's topology or, preferably, with a geometric selector (where + expect) that Schemaxis resolves again for every design variant and rechecks after reopening. Apply it late in the feature tree, after booleans, as the FreeCAD documentation advises; use chamfer for a flat bevel.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The default edges [1] is just the first edge of the base topology; always choose edges deliberately (inspect the base node with schemaxis inspect --node).
- A radius too large for the adjacent faces makes FreeCAD fail the fillet; planning cannot detect this.
- A selector must match exactly expect edges; otherwise the run fails (EMPTY_SELECTION, AMBIGUOUS_SELECTION or SELECTION_COUNT_MISMATCH) instead of rounding other edges.

Native binding: `Part::Fillet`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | Constant fillet radius in millimetres, applied to every selected edge (each native edge entry uses the same start and end radius). A larger radius removes more material; a radius too large for the faces meeting at an edge makes FreeCAD fail the fillet. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `1` |
| `edges` | Which edges of the base solid to round: either a list of one-based edge indices or a geometric selector with an exact expected count. The selection always refers to the base input's edges, not to the fillet result; Schemaxis resolves it, assigns the indices to the native feature and rechecks them after reopening. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1000,"uniqueItems":true},{"type":"object","properties":{"where":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"curve":{"type":"enum","values":["line","circle"]},"parallelTo":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-1000000.0,"maximum":1000000.0},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3},"onPlane":{"type":"object","properties":{"axis":{"type":"enum","values":["x","y","z"],"required":true},"coordinate":{"type":"number","required":true}}},"length":{"type":"object","properties":{"minimum":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"required":true},"maximum":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"required":true}}}}},"expect":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"tolerance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":0.01,"default":1e-06},"angularTolerance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":0.01,"default":1e-06}}}]}` | `[1]` |
